model.name: R19.93: File detail view has a Preview button to open the ContentPreviewer.
model.description: The file DETAIL VIEW (detail drawer showing FILE scenario unit metadata: Scenario link, Parent link, etc.) currently has NO preview/open button. FIX: add a PREVIEW button (like the in-room preview buttons per R19.77) that opens the ContentPreviewer for this file — image renders as img, html in sandboxed iframe, url shows the two-button choice. The preview button appears alongside Scenario/Parent/Browse links in the detail view header.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add on the file details view a preview button"
model.crossRefNote: R19.63 (file click → preview in drawer) and R19.65 (ContentPreviewer) define the preview system. R19.77 (URL two buttons) defines the button pattern. R19.93 adds the preview button to the file DETAIL VIEW (not just the in-room tree click path).
